title: Add community knowledge: AL boolean operators do not short-circuit
summary: Two community knowledge articles explain AL's lack of short-circuit evaluation for boolean operators and recommend using case statements as alternatives for complex condition chains.
key_points: AL gives no short-circuit guarantee for and, or or xor, so guards should not rely on operand order
Shows silent bugs such as reading a field from a record Get did not load, or evaluating an out-of-range subscript
For or, use an early exit (if A then exit(true); exit(B);) rather than the nested if rewrite used for and
Recommends case true/false of as a flat alternative once a guard chain goes past about three nested ifs
Includes good and bad AL samples for both articles
quote: AL gives no short-circuit (lazy) evaluation guarantee for `and`, `or`, or `xor`.
